name: Jovvie In Person Payments for Event Tickets
author: bizswoop

sections.description:
Jovvie In Person Payments for Event Tickets and The Events Calendar enables event organizers to accept in person cards and tap to pay payments using Stripe. The plugin integrates directly with Event Tickets and is designed to work seamlessly alongside The Events Calendar when it is installed.

Event Tickets is required to manage ticket sales inventory orders and attendees. The Events Calendar plugin is optional but commonly used to create and manage events that tickets are associated with.

This plugin is ideal for event teams venues and organizations that want to accept card present payments while keeping ticket data unified without relying on external point of sale systems.

With Jovvie you can

  • Accept in person ticket payments using Event Tickets

  • Associate ticket orders with events created using The Events Calendar when installed

  • Use Tap to Pay on compatible iOS and Android devices

  • Accept chip swipe or tap payments using Stripe Terminal readers

  • Process payments directly through your Stripe account

Supported Stripe countries include Australia Austria Belgium Canada Czech Republic Denmark Finland France Germany Ireland Italy Japan Luxembourg Malaysia Mexico Netherlands New Zealand Norway Poland Portugal Singapore Spain Sweden Switzerland United Kingdom United States

Requirements

  • Event Tickets

  • A free Stripe account

Optional:

  • The Events Calendar

How Jovvie Enables In Person Payments

Jovvie is an official Stripe partner and connects Stripe with Event Tickets to enable secure card present payments. When The Events Calendar is installed ticket orders are automatically associated with their corresponding events.

During setup you connect your Stripe account create a payment location and register a Tap to Pay device or Stripe reader. Once configured you can accept in person ticket payments using your existing ticketing workflow.

Stripe handles payment processing and PCI compliance while Jovvie manages device connections and ticket payment orchestration inside WordPress.

Why Use Jovvie with Event Tickets

  • Sell tickets directly at events and venues

  • Reduce checkout friction with fast contactless payments

  • Eliminate manual cash handling

  • Keep online and in person ticket sales unified

  • Maintain a single source of truth for tickets and attendees

Key Features

  • Tap to Pay support on compatible iOS and Android devices

  • Support for Stripe Terminal readers including M2 S700 BBPOS WisePad 3 and BBPOS WisePOS E

  • Secure PCI compliant payments through Stripe

  • Payments recorded as standard Event Tickets orders

  • Real time ticket inventory updates

  • Optimized for mobile and kiosk workflows

  • Transparent pricing with no hidden monthly fees

Integrations and Compatibility

  • Event Tickets

  • The Events Calendar (optional)

  • Stripe

  • Stripe Terminal hardware

  • Tap to Pay on supported iOS and Android mobile devices

Steps to Get Started

  • Install and activate Event Tickets

  • Install and activate Jovvie In Person Payments for Event Tickets and The Events Calendar

  • Connect your Stripe account in the Jovvie settings

  • Create a payment location and register a device or reader

  • Enable in person payments for your tickets

  • Start accepting ticket payments on site

Support

Support is available at Contact Support
sections.installation:
Upload the plugin zip file to the wp content plugins directory

Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu

Ensure Event Tickets is active

Configure Stripe and devices in the Jovvie settings

Enable in person payments for your tickets
sections.faq:
Q: Is The Events Calendar required
A: No Event Tickets is required. The Events Calendar is optional and supported when installed

Q: Do I need a Stripe account
A: Yes a free Stripe account is required to process payments

Q: Can I use Tap to Pay without hardware
A: Yes Tap to Pay works on supported iOS and Android devices

Q: Are ticket sales recorded in Event Tickets
A: Yes all in person payments create standard Event Tickets orders

Q: What readers are supported
A: Stripe Terminal readers including M2 S700 BBPOS WisePad 3 and WisePOS E
